_about: The first scheme whose inciting event happens where the player is not, and the
first that does not open at the market. `docs/architecture.md` promises that the
world clock ticks on its own and that a rival advances while you were elsewhere —
'this is where hooks come from for free' — and nothing shipped had ever shown it.
News is the whole mechanism. A courier carries word out of the region on a day's
delay, and the tag it grants is `knows.news.<step id>`, which is what the later
steps wait on. Until that word arrives there is nothing to do and nothing is asked.
Both endings are endings. The one that fires when the player never goes is not a
failure state: it kills somebody out of sight, says so through the log and the
secret card, and resolves. A quest that can only be abandoned sits on the board
forever, which the fairness critic caught in the shipped line.

schemes.title: Word from the road
schemes.about: A party is overdue, the word comes late, and they did not want finding.

cards.title: Find out what happened to $factor's people
objectives: Wait for word, or go and look
cards.reward: what the wagons were carrying, less what $factor is owed

cards.title: Why $overdue is not coming back
facts: $overdue is out past $wild and in no trouble at all: the wagons went the other way on purpose.
$factor's tally has been short for long enough that $overdue stopped expecting it to be honest.

grants_on_open.say: $factor read the tally out twice and the two readings were not the same

action.says: A rider out of the country past $wild says the wagons went by and did not stop.

tell.silent: A rider is on the way to $lodging with word about $overdue.

tell.perceptible: $overdue is out here past $wild, unhurt, and not surprised to be found.

action.text: $overdue went the other way on purpose, because $factor's tally was never going to come right.

tell.perceptible: $overdue says the tally was short every season, and stopped waiting for $factor to notice.
$factor gets the answer at $lodging, and does not ask a second question.

also.text: Whatever was out past $wild found $overdue before anybody went to look.

tell.silent: $overdue does not come back, and $factor stops asking at $lodging.
